claim: Patchline ships a formal information-theoretic bound on detectable hazards from a given feature set. The worker loads a frozen, content-addressed spec and checks every item is scored and references concrete backing evidence; the gate then re-runs the worker, confirms every item is scored and evidenced, and rejects an unsupported item with empty evidence, so the information-theoretic claim is reproducible on real Patchline self-data via `make information-theoretic-bound-gate`.
